name: year
description: Reference year of the quarter-end observation

name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4
observations: APRA labels each quarter by its final month: Q1 March, Q2 June, Q3 September, Q4 December

name: fund_type
description: Superannuation fund type: all (whole industry), corporate, industry, public sector or retail funds
observations: APRA regulates only these fund types; self-managed super funds (SMSFs) are regulated by the ATO and are not covered

name: net_assets_beginning
description: Net assets available to pay benefits at the beginning of the quarter
observations: Values in millions of Australian dollars
original_name: Net assets at beginning of the period ($m)

name: net_cash_flows
description: Net cash flows during the quarter, an input to the rate-of-return calculation
observations: Values in millions of Australian dollars

name: cash_flow_adjusted_net_assets
description: Cash-flow adjusted net assets, an input to the rate-of-return calculation
observations: Values in millions of Australian dollars

name: investment_income
description: Investment income earned during the quarter
observations: Values in millions of Australian dollars

name: investment_expense
description: Investment expense used in the rate-of-return calculation
observations: Values in millions of Australian dollars

name: operating_income
observations: Values in millions of Australian dollars

name: administration_and_operating_expense
description: Administration and operating expense used in the rate-of-return calculation
observations: Values in millions of Australian dollars

name: income_tax_expense_benefit
description: Income tax expense or benefit for the quarter
observations: Values in millions of Australian dollars

name: net_earnings_after_tax
description: Net earnings after tax during the quarter
observations: Values in millions of Australian dollars

name: rate_of_return
description: Quarterly rate of return, expressed as a proportion (e.g. 0.056 = 5.6%)
observations: Dimensionless proportion; APRA labels it a percentage but stores a fraction

name: five_year_annualised_rate_of_return
description: Five-year annualised rate of return, expressed as a proportion
observations: Dimensionless proportion; APRA labels it a percentage but stores a fraction
original_name: Five year annualised Rate of Return (%)

name: number_of_entities
description: Number of superannuation entities in the fund type
